summary: Possible typosquat of @solana/web3.js with postinstall script
details: Package name `@solana-labs/web3js` closely resembles the well-known `@solana/web3.js` Solana JavaScript SDK (different scope, missing dot in name). The package declares a `postinstall` lifecycle hook (`node install.js`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. The contents of `install.js` were not fully traced, so the actual behavior of the install-time script is unverified. The combination of a name resembling a popular crypto SDK and an unverified postinstall script is a common shape for supply-chain droppers; human review of `install.js` is required to confirm intent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
